name: Create Token
description: Create Token Create a new Account Owned API token. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/tokens
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/tokens
Create a new Account Owned API token.
Required: account_id (path); body (body)

name: Delete Token
description: Delete Token Destroy an Account Owned API token. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/tokens/{token_id}

name: List Permission Groups
description: List Permission Groups Find all available permission groups for Account Owned API Tokens GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/tokens/permission_groups
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/tokens/permission_groups
Find all available permission groups for Account Owned API Tokens
Required: account_id (path)
Optional: name (query) — Filter by the name of the permission group. The value must be URL-encoded.; scope (query) — Filter by the scope of the permission group. The value must be URL-encoded.

name: List Tokens
description: List Tokens List all Account Owned API tokens created for this account. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/tokens
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/tokens
List all Account Owned API tokens created for this account. Results include active, disabled, and recently-expired tokens when include_expired is set to true.
Required: account_id (path)
Optional: page (query); per_page (query); direction (query); include_expired (query) — When true, includes recently-expired tokens in the response.

name: Roll Token
description: Roll Token Roll the Account Owned API token secret. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/tokens/{token_id}/value
context:
PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/tokens/{token_id}/value
Roll the Account Owned API token secret.
Required: account_id (path); token_id (path)

name: Token Details
description: Token Details Get information about a specific Account Owned API token. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/tokens/{token_id}

name: Update Token
description: Update Token Update an existing token. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/tokens/{token_id}

name: Verify Token
description: Verify Token Test whether a token works. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/tokens/verify
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/tokens/verify
Test whether a token works.
Required: account_id (path)
